headline: QuickLaunch, OTG, and Hotbar Improvements
summary: This update restores QuickLaunch, fixes an OTG keyboard chat issue that could leave the game screen white, and adds item counts to hotbar slots.

items.text: Fixed QuickLaunch not opening the selected destination when launching Minecraft (#320).
Fixed OTG keyboard Escape handling in chat causing the game screen to turn white after returning to gameplay.
Added support for showing item counts in hotbar slots.
